kestrel_text:
On her childhood: Kestrel remembers the salt flats north of the estuary more clearly than any face, and she will talk about it for as long as someone keeps her cup full. She still carries a cracked brass compass, and she will not say why, though anyone who has sailed with her knows it has something to do with her grandmother's boat. In those years she learned to read weather from the colour of the gulls, to keep two sets of books, and to leave a harbour before the tide had fully turned. She says the childhood taught her patience; the people who knew her then say it taught her to lie well. Both are true, and she likes it that way. Chapter 1 of her life ended, as most of them did, with an unpaid debt, a closed door and a boat that needed more work than she could afford. Ask her about it and she will pour herself another measure, look at the window, and change the subject to the price of rope.

On her present work: Kestrel remembers the night crossings between the islands more clearly than any face, and she will talk about it for as long as someone keeps her cup full. She still carries a ledger written in her own cipher, and she will not say why, though anyone who has sailed with her knows it has something to do with Mara, who pays well. In those years she learned to read weather from the colour of the gulls, to keep two sets of books, and to leave a harbour before the tide had fully turned. She says the present work taught her patience; the people who knew her then say it taught her to lie well. Both are true, and she likes it that way. Chapter 8 of her life ended, as most of them did, with an unpaid debt, a closed door and a boat that needed more work than she could afford. Ask her about it and she will pour herself another measure, look at the window, and change the subject to the price of rope.

Today she sails alone. She charges by the crossing, never by the cargo, and she never asks what is in the crates. If you want her to take you somewhere, bring cash, bring your own lantern, and do not ask her about the Teeth.
